children: Overview
US insurance provider's Q3 net income rose 1.5% yr/yr, core operating income down 2.2%
Consolidated net premiums written grew 1.9% yr/yr, with P&C and Life segments both up
P&C combined ratio increased to 84.1% from 81.8% last year, reflecting higher catastrophe losses
Outlook
Chubb expects North America commercial premium growth to improve in future quarters
Company sees continued growth opportunities from global diversification and rising interest rates
Chubb aims for strong growth in operating earnings, EPS, and double-digit tangible book value growth
Result Drivers
HIGHER CATASTROPHE LOSSES - Co said increased catastrophe losses contributed to higher P&C combined ratio and lower core operating income
INVESTMENT INCOME - Record adjusted net investment income supported results, aided by rising interest rates and favorable fixed-income environment
OVERSEAS GENERAL GROWTH - Overseas General segment net premiums written rose 6.7%, with strong growth in Latin America, Asia and Europe
